title: 040 regime-state amendment (user request 2026-10-22): predict the FUTURE bear/sideways/bull state S_H(t+H) with a stand-in, a regime-only NNMT and the multi-task NNMT; trading arms only for passing cells
label: PROVISIONAL -- one era (2023-26); halves are the persistence test. Committed before any future-state label is built or scored.
why: NNMT's regime label is a centred 200-bar mean (~95 future bars inside the label) and its head has task weight 0 (never trained): heads_descriptive_mt_lr_ri.json, regime AUC 0.64/0.66 < trailing baseline 0.79/0.78. A gate or sizer needs the state AHEAD; the current causal state needs no model.
amends: preregistration_transition.json (same folds, halves, rows, state definition, causality check, stand-in inputs, fit/tail windows, paired/risk maps). Nothing in the transition study changes.

definition.state: S_H(t) exactly as preregistration_transition.json definition (z_H with sigma_window 2880 / min 960, deadband 0.5): BEAR -1, SIDEWAYS 0, BULL +1
definition.target: Y = S_H(t+H), 3 classes; NaN where S_H(t) or S_H(t+H) is unknown

grid.note: 6 cells; 96/288/672 bars = 1/3/7 days; btc = BTC's state joined by date, predicted on every pair's rows

rows: as preregistration_transition.json: tradeable bars (meta:data_ok, volume > 0) of the 10 screen pairs
causality: transition causality must PASS (T042) before any screen here runs; the target's future end is the label by design and never an input

stand_in.model: sklearn HistGradientBoostingClassifier, ONE multiclass (3-class) model per cell and fold; hyperparameters, inputs (24 indicators + raw8 + BTC raw8 + z_L state inputs), fit window (purge H), hourly subsample, tail_days 90 and random_state 0 exactly as preregistration_transition.json stand_in

baselines.markov: P(Y = k | S_H(t) = j): empirical 3x3 transition matrix estimated on the same fit rows as the stand-in (per fold, cell); score = the row of the current state
baselines.trailing_z: z_H(t) for BULL, -z_H(t) for BEAR (continuous persistence)
baselines.baseline_auc: max(0.5, AUC(markov), AUC(trailing_z)) per class and half

screen_rule.auc: one-vs-rest AUC of P(class) against (Y == class), tradeable test bars pooled per half
screen_rule.margin: AUC - baseline_auc, per class (BULL, BEAR) and half
screen_rule.events: run starts of (Y == class) per pair
screen_rule.proxy: top decile of each fold's scored test bars by P(class), pooled per half: BULL -> mean forward H-bar log return of the pair in bp minus 30 > 0; BEAR -> top-decile mean minus all-bar mean <= -30
screen_rule.pass: per (cell, class): margin >= 0.02 in BOTH halves AND events >= 200 in both halves AND the proxy passes in both halves
screen_rule.selection: per class, the passing cell with the largest late-half margin goes forward

nn.M: the R7 selection in verdicts_models.json at build time (mt_lr_ri as of this commit; follows the seed-2 result if it changes)
nn.cell: the selected cell of either class (BEAR first if both classes select different cells, since the gate uses BEAR); if NO cell passes, the declared fallback cell H = 288, level pair (037: predictable horizon) -- then the NN results are descriptive only and no arm runs

models.<M>_rg: regime-only: the regime head retargeted to Y (3 classes), task weights trading 0, regime 1, risk 0, momentum 0, flow 0, profit 0
models.<M>_rgm: multi-task: <M>'s task weights (trading 4, risk 1, momentum 1, flow 1, profit 0) with the retargeted regime head at weight 1

nn.label_rule: the regime label of a training row is Y; rows whose t+H lies after the fold's train_timerange end, or where Y is NaN, carry no regime loss (masked or dropped) -- never filled from bars outside the training range
nn.model_key: the retargeted label and the task weights are weight-shaping: both NN models must get new model keys (no reuse of <M>'s weights); a test asserts it
nn.training: 15 folds each, seed 1, one trainer at a time, sequential after the seed-2 chain and T035
nn.screen: each NN's P(BULL), P(BEAR) are screened with screen_rule on the selected cell (same baselines, same proxy)
nn.shared_vs_separate: descriptive: per class and half, AUC(<M>_rgm) - AUC(<M>_rg); 'sharing helps' if >= +0.01 in both halves, 'sharing hurts' if <= -0.01 in both, else 'no difference'
nn.replaces_stand_in: an NN's tables replace the stand-in's in the arms if its AUC is >= the stand-in's minus 0.01 in both halves (if both NNs qualify: the higher late-half AUC); tail percentiles from its TRAIN_DATA_SPLIT holdout

rs_gate.use: cs_aro's book skips an entry while P(BEAR, selected cell) >= the 80th percentile of that fold's tail predictions

rs_scale.needs: a passing BULL or BEAR cell (a class with no passing cell leaves its side unscaled)
rs_scale.use: cs_aro's stake x1.333 when P(BULL) >= tail p80, x0.667 when P(BEAR) >= tail p80 (both: unchanged)

{M}_rgm.needs: nothing (runs whenever <M>_rgm is trained, at the operating point): does training a real regime head change the trading head's P&L?
{M}_rgm.use: the <M>_rgm model as entry source, operating point exactly as {M}

rule.decision: research.nnnc_switches.judge.judge_one with these maps (as the transition study): PASS = early gain > 0 AND late gain > 0 AND paired not WORSENED AND Sharpe and maxDD not WORSENED; INCONCLUSIVE if control trades < min_control_trades, no fold changed, or a map gives 'inconclusive'; a PASS with total gain < seed_rule_pp needs a seed-2 rerun before any claim

seeds: any arm PASS is re-run on seed 2 (stand-in: random_state 1; NN: MODEL_SEED 2)
seen_before: heads_descriptive_mt_lr_ri.json (abbc0516): NNMT's centred regime head, untrained, AUC 0.64/0.66 vs trailing baseline 0.79/0.78 -- a different target; no future-state label has been built or scored
037: regime-style targets beat persistence only at 48/288 bars (12 h / 3 days); price-level and calendar columns made spurious winners (not inputs here)
the transition study (preregistration_transition.json) is committed but not yet run: no transition label or screen result exists
